pew-coexist.title: Who thinks a way can be found for Israel and an independent Palestinian state to coexist peacefully, 2013–2026
pew-coexist.question: "Do you think a way can be found for Israel and an independent Palestinian state to coexist peacefully with each other?" Percent saying a way can be found. This asks whether coexistence is possible, not whether people want it.
pew-coexist.source: Pew Research Center, Global Attitudes surveys, as published in its Sept 15, 2026 report
pew-coexist.date: Spring of each year; 2026 fieldwork April 5–May 6, 2026
pew-coexist.note: Pew's label for the third column is "Arab Israelis". In 2026, 46% of Arab respondents gave no answer; 26% said a way cannot be found. Pew says the 2026 overall figure (17%) has not changed significantly from 2025 (21%). The 2014 figure for Jewish Israelis (37%) is from this Global Attitudes series; Pew's separate 2014–15 survey of religion in Israel, asking the same question, found 43% (see the note on the page).

rows.label: "The creation of an independent Palestinian state alongside the State of Israel"
"Annexation of the occupied territories and the creation of one state under Israeli rule with limited rights for Palestinians"

peace-index-options.question: "Regarding each of the following solutions to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, please state to what extent you support or oppose each of them." (March 2026 wording.) Percent of Jewish respondents who very much or moderately support.
peace-index-options.source: Peace Index, Tel Aviv University (Nimrod Rosler and Alon Yakter)
peace-index-options.sample: About 610 Israeli adults per wave, online (March 2026: 504 Jews, 103 Arabs)
peace-index-options.note: Each option is rated separately, so the shares do not add up to 100. Sept 2023 values are read from the Peace Index chart; March 2026 values are rounded from 22.7, 37.7, 31.1 and 7.5. Sept 2023 report: https://en-social-sciences.tau.ac.il/sites/socsci-english.tau.ac.il/files/media_server/social/peaceindex/2023-09.pdf; Nov 2025 report: https://en-social-sciences.tau.ac.il/sites/socsci-english.tau.ac.il/files/media_server/social/peaceindex/2025-11.pdf

peace-index-camps.title: Jewish Israelis who support a Palestinian state alongside Israel, by political camp, March 2026
peace-index-camps.question: Support for "the creation of an independent Palestinian state alongside the State of Israel", among Jewish respondents who gave an opinion, by self-placement on the political spectrum.
peace-index-camps.sample: 504 Jewish respondents; shares among those who gave an opinion
peace-index-camps.note: Among opinion-holders only, so these figures are not comparable with the 23% of all Jewish respondents in the chart above.
